source_snapshot.title: UAE school exam cheating: Zero grade, 12 conduct points lost and no make-up exam, schools warn
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: A number of schools have warned that cheating or helping others to cheat could result in a zero grade in the subject, a deduction of 12 points from conduct, and disqualification from the make-up exam, ahead of the start of the end-of-first-semester exams for the 2026-2027 academic year, scheduled for November 25 for students from grades three to twelve. The anti-cheating regulations specify seven prohibitions for students, including: Using mobile phones or social media during the exam. Exchanging conversations, signals, or any form of communication between students inside the hall. Looking at or copying other people’s answers. Leaking questions or participating in distributing them. Intentionally damaging the exam paper or the contents of the hall. Impersonating others in school transactions or when entering exam halls. Using external parties to accomplish learning or project-based assessment tasks. The Ministry of Education's guidelines classify cheating as a serious offence. If a student is caught cheating, they receive zero marks in the subject in which the violation occurred. If the violation is proven for the first time, 12 points are deducted from their conduct grade, they are barred from taking the make-up exam, and their guardian is notified of the decision. If cheating is repeated, whether via using social media or any other means, the student receives zero marks in all subjects within Group A and is referred to a behavioural modification program in cooperation with their guardian, in addition to the penalties stipulated in the code of conduct. The procedures extend to cases captured by cameras. If a photo or video shows a student cheating, they will receive zero marks on the exam and be subject to the prescribed disciplinary action. Guidelines for cases captured by cameras stipulate a zero in all subjects for repeated offences. The school investigates the incident, documents its details in a dedicated form, informs the student of what has been recorded against him/her, then refers the case to the relevant authority, and involves the parent in the procedures taken. The Ministry stressed that allowing or assisting students to cheat is a serious violation of the code of conduct, which warrants holding the teacher accountable. It indicated that it is taking the necessary measures to monitor the progress of exams in schools, and to detect and follow up on cases of cheating.

claims.claim: In UAE schools, strict measures against cheating in exams starting November 25, 2026, for students from grades 3 to 12 have been introduced.
Violations including use of phones and exchanging answers result in zero marks in the subject, loss of 12 conduct points, and ban from retake exams.
Repeated violations lead to zero marks in all Group A subjects and referral to a behavioral correction program.
Violations recorded on camera also lead to strict punishments.
Teachers who assist cheating will be held accountable.

title: UAE school exam cheating: Zero grade, 12 conduct points lost and no make-up exam, schools warn
summary_ru: 🎓 В школах ОАЭ ввели строгие меры против списывания на экзаменах, которые начнутся 25 ноября 2026 года для учеников с 3 по 12 класс. За нарушение правил, включая использование телефонов и обмен ответами, студентам грозит ноль баллов по предмету, потеря 12 баллов за поведение и запрет на пересдачу. При повторных нарушениях ноль ставят по всем предметам группы А, а учеников направляют на программу коррекции поведения. 📸 Нарушения, зафиксированные на камеру, также приводят к строгим наказаниям. Учителя, помогающие списывать, будут привлечены к ответственности.
